DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23223-02-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23223-02-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: どのようなご案内が必要でしょうか。

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23223-02-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23223-02-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 子どもが読み終えた本を、ほかの人に使ってもらいたいです。図書館などへ寄付できるか、相談先を教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23223-02-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 読み終え児童書を活用したく寄付相談先を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23223-02-001-SHARED-02.translation: I would like other people to use the books my child has finished reading. Please tell me whom to ask about donating them to a library or somewhere similar.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23223-02-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask whom to consult about donating children's books that have been read so others can use them. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23223-02-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23223-02-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 寄付の受入れは施設ごとに確認が必要です。どのような本ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23223-02-001-SHARED-03.translation: You need to check whether each facility accepts donations. What kinds of books are they?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23223-02-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23223-02-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 日本語の児童書が十冊です。家の本棚で使っていた物で、破れがある本は別にしています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23223-02-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 日本語十冊と破れ本は除外した状態を説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23223-02-001-SHARED-04.translation: There are ten children's books in Japanese. We kept and used them on our bookshelf at home, and I have set aside any torn books.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23223-02-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that there are ten Japanese books and that you have excluded the torn ones. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23223-02-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23223-02-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 図書館の担当へ、種類と状態をお伝えください。現物を持ち込む前に問い合わせるとよいでしょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23223-02-001-SHARED-05.translation: Tell the library staff what kind of books they are and their condition. It would be best to inquire before bringing the actual books in.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23223-02-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23223-02-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 十冊を箱ごと持って行けば受け取ってもらえると思っていました。先に電話して、受入れの条件を聞きます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23223-02-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 未照会持込を避け電話で受入条件を聞くと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23223-02-001-SHARED-06.translation: I thought they would accept the ten books if I brought the whole box. I will call first and ask about their conditions for accepting donations.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23223-02-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say that you will avoid bringing the books without inquiring and will call to ask about acceptance conditions. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23223-02-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23223-02-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: こちらに問い合わせ先の案内があります。寄付ができない場合の扱いも、ご自身でお考えください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23223-02-001-SHARED-07.translation: Here is the contact information. Please also consider for yourself what you will do if you cannot donate them.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23223-02-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23223-02-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 受け取れない本があれば、家に残します。箱を運ぶ前に、受け取れる冊数と持ち込む日を確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23223-02-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 受入れ不可の本は自宅に残し冊数と持込日を事前確認すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23223-02-001-SHARED-08.translation: If there are any books they cannot accept, I will leave them at home. Before carrying the box over, I will check how many books they can accept and the date I should bring them.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23223-02-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say that you will leave unacceptable books at home and check the number of books and delivery date in advance. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23223-02-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23223-02-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 本の題名や発行年も、分かる範囲で用意してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23223-02-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please also prepare the titles and publication years of the books as far as you know them.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23223-02-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23223-02-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 家で題名と発行年の一覧を作ります。十冊という数だけでなく、状態も説明して相談します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23223-02-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 題名発行年状態一覧を準備して相談すると話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23223-02-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will make a list of the titles and publication years at home. When I ask, I will explain their condition as well as the fact that there are ten books.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23223-02-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say that you will prepare a list of titles, publication years and conditions before consulting them. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23223-02-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23223-02-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: それでは、こちらの案内をどうぞ。お気をつけてお帰りください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23223-02-001-SHARED-11.translation: Here is the information, then. Have a safe journey home.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23223-03-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23223-03-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 診察の準備で、お名前とお持ちの診察券を確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23223-03-001-SHARED-01.translation: To prepare for your consultation, I will check your name and the patient card you have.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23223-03-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23223-03-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: グエン・アンです。さっき出したカードを見たら、病院の名前が違いました。別の病院の診察券を出していたようです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23223-03-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 自分の名前を伝え提出した診察券の病院名が違うと申告する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23223-03-001-SHARED-02.translation: My name is Nguyen An. When I looked at the card I handed over earlier, I noticed the hospital name was different. It seems I gave you a patient card from another hospital.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23223-03-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Give your name and report that the hospital name on the patient card you submitted is different. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23223-03-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23223-03-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: こちらのカードも、ご本人の物でしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23223-03-001-SHARED-03.translation: Does this card also belong to you?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23223-03-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23223-03-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: はい、私の名前です。ただ、以前別の病院でもらった物です。この病院は今日初めて来ました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23223-03-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 他院の自分の診察券で今回の病院は初診と説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23223-03-001-SHARED-04.translation: Yes, it has my name. However, I received it at another hospital before. This is my first visit to this hospital.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23223-03-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that it is your own patient card from another hospital and this is your first visit here. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23223-03-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23223-03-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 初めての受診として受付の状態を確認します。こちらの番号を今回の診察番号として扱わずにお待ちください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23223-03-001-SHARED-05.translation: We will check your registration as a first-time patient. Please wait, and do not regard the number on this card as your consultation number for this visit.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23223-03-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23223-03-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 分かりました。予約した時のメールならあります。こちらの病院名と、今日の予約日が載っているのでお見せします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23223-03-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 今回の病院名と予約日が載るメールを提示する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23223-03-001-SHARED-06.translation: Understood. I do have the email from when I made the appointment. It shows this hospital's name and today's appointment date, so I will show it to you.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23223-03-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Show the email containing this hospital's name and the appointment date. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23223-03-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23223-03-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 予約の情報とご本人の名前を、受付担当へ確認します。カードは一度お返しします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23223-03-001-SHARED-07.translation: I will check the appointment information and your name with the reception staff. I will return the card to you for now.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23223-03-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23223-03-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: カードを返してもらえますか。今後取り違えないよう、別の病院の物だと分かる所へしまっておきたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23223-03-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 他院の診察券返却を頼み区別して収納したいと話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23223-03-001-SHARED-08.translation: Could you return the card? I would like to put it somewhere that makes it clear it is from a different hospital, so I do not mix them up again.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23223-03-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Ask for the other hospital's patient card back and say that you want to store it separately to distinguish it. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23223-03-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23223-03-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: こちらのカードをお返しします。この病院で必要な登録や資料は、受付担当から改めてご案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23223-03-001-SHARED-09.translation: Here is your card back. The reception staff will explain again what registration or documents are needed at this hospital.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23223-03-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23223-03-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 受け取りました。別の病院のカードはかばんへしまい、予約のメールを開いて待ちます。こちらの受付がどうなっているか、確認をお願いします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23223-03-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 他院カードを回収し予約メールを示したまま今回の受付確認を依頼する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23223-03-001-SHARED-10.translation: I have it. I will put the other hospital's card in my bag and wait with the appointment email open. Please check the status of my registration here.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23223-03-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Take back the other hospital's card and ask for confirmation of your registration here while keeping the appointment email displayed. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23223-03-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23223-03-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 予約と受付の状態を確認してきます。そのままこちらでお待ちください。それでは、失礼します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23223-03-001-SHARED-11.translation: I will go and check your appointment and registration status. Please stay here and wait. Excuse me.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23223-04-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23223-04-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 地域の活動について、ご相談でしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23223-04-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you here to ask about local community activities?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23223-04-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23223-04-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。近所で夜の見回りをしている人を見ました。私も参加したいですが、勝手に一人で始めず相談先を知りたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23223-04-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 夜見回りへの初参加希望で独断実施せず相談先を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23223-04-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. I saw people patrolling the neighborhood at night. I would like to join too, but I want to know whom to consult rather than starting on my own without asking.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23223-04-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say that you want to join night patrols for the first time and ask whom to consult instead of acting on your own. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23223-04-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23223-04-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 活動の担当団体を確認しましょう。見かけたのは、どの地区ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23223-04-001-SHARED-03.translation: Let's check which organization runs the activity. In which district did you see them?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23223-04-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23223-04-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: この地区です。黄色い腕章の人を二人見かけました。団体の名前までは読めなかったので、こちらへ聞きに来ました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23223-04-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 地区と腕章を見たが団体名は不明という手掛かりを伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23223-04-001-SHARED-04.translation: This district. I saw two people wearing yellow armbands. I could not read the organization's name, so I came here to ask.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23223-04-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Provide the clues that you saw the district and armbands but do not know the organization's name. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23223-04-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23223-04-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 地域の活動として、担当への問い合わせ方法をご案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23223-04-001-SHARED-05.translation: I will explain how to contact those responsible for this community activity.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23223-04-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23223-04-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: お願いします。初めてなので、いきなり一人で歩く役を引き受けず、経験のある人と一緒にできるか聞きたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23223-04-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 初心者として経験者と同行可否を担当へ聞きたいと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23223-04-001-SHARED-06.translation: Please do. Since I am new, I want to ask whether I can join someone experienced instead of immediately accepting a role walking alone.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23223-04-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say that, as a beginner, you want to ask those in charge whether you can accompany an experienced participant. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23223-04-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23223-04-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 参加方法や活動の時間は、その団体へご確認ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23223-04-001-SHARED-07.translation: Please check with that organization about how to join and the activity times.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23223-04-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23223-04-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 仕事が終わるのは六時です。参加できる日と時間を伝え、活動の説明を聞いてから決めます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23223-04-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 終業十八時と参加可能日時を示し説明後決定すると話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23223-04-001-SHARED-08.translation: I finish work at six. I will tell them the days and times I can participate, listen to an explanation of the activity, and then decide.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23223-04-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say that you finish work at 6 p.m., state when you can participate, and say that you will decide after hearing the explanation. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23223-04-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23223-04-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 個人の連絡先を担当へ知らせる際も、ご自身で確認してお伝えください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23223-04-001-SHARED-09.translation: When giving your personal contact information to those in charge, please also check for yourself before providing it.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23223-04-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23223-04-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 確認できたら、問い合わせ先をメモします。参加できる曜日と時間も整理して、担当の方へ連絡します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23223-04-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 確認後に問い合わせ先を記録し参加可能日時を整理して連絡すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23223-04-001-SHARED-10.translation: Once I have confirmed it, I will note down the contact details. I will also organize the days of the week and times I can participate and contact the person in charge.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23223-04-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say that after confirming the contact details, you will record them, organize your available dates and times, and get in touch. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23223-04-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23223-04-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: それでは、問い合わせ先の案内を確認します。少しお待ちください。失礼します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23223-04-001-SHARED-11.translation: I will check the contact information, then. Please wait a moment. Excuse me.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23223-05-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23223-05-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 返信用のはがきを、お出しになりますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23223-05-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you sending a reply postcard?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23223-05-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23223-05-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。結婚式へ出席すると書きました。でも返事の期限は昨日でした。今日出せば、まだ出席として受け付けてもらえますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23223-05-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 結婚式返信期限翌日で当日投函が出席受理になるか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23223-05-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. I wrote that I will attend the wedding. But the reply deadline was yesterday. If I post it today, will my attendance still be accepted?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23223-05-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask whether posting a wedding reply the day after the deadline will count as an accepted attendance reply. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23223-05-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23223-05-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 配達できるかと、相手が返信を受け付けるかは別です。出欠については、ご友人へ確認してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23223-05-001-SHARED-03.translation: Whether it can be delivered and whether the recipient accepts the reply are separate matters. Please check with your friend about attending.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23223-05-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23223-05-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 分かりました。今から友人へ電話して、返事が遅れたことを謝り、出席できるか聞きます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23223-05-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 友人へ遅い返信を謝り出席受入れを確認すると話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23223-05-001-SHARED-04.translation: Understood. I will call my friend now, apologize for replying late, and ask whether I can attend.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23223-05-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say that you will apologize to your friend for the late reply and check whether they can accept your attendance. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23223-05-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23223-05-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 宛先の方と連絡できそうでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23223-05-001-SHARED-05.translation: Do you think you can get in touch with the addressee?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23223-05-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23223-05-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 携帯の連絡先があります。出席したいことと、はがきをまだ出していないことを伝えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23223-05-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 所持連絡先へ出席希望と未投函を伝えると話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23223-05-001-SHARED-06.translation: I have their mobile contact details. I will tell them that I want to attend and that I have not posted the card yet.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23223-05-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say that you will use the contact details you have to explain that you want to attend and have not posted the card. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23223-05-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23223-05-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 確認のために、はがきはいったんお戻ししますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23223-05-001-SHARED-07.translation: Would you like the postcard back for now while you check?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23223-05-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23223-05-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: はい、はがきは一度戻してください。友人の返事を聞いてから出したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23223-05-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 本人への確認後に発送するためはがき返却を依頼する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23223-05-001-SHARED-08.translation: Yes, please give me the card back for now. I would like to send it after hearing my friend's answer.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23223-05-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Ask for the postcard back so that you can send it after checking with the recipient. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23223-05-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23223-05-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: こちらをお返しします。お出しになる際は、はがきの宛先もご確認ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23223-05-001-SHARED-09.translation: Here it is. When sending it, please also check the postcard's address.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23223-05-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23223-05-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 受け取りました。友人が今必要とする返答方法を聞いてから、はがきも必要なら出しに戻ります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23223-05-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 必要な返答手段を聞きはがき必要時再発送と述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23223-05-001-SHARED-10.translation: I have it. I will ask what method of reply my friend needs now, and if the postcard is also needed, I will come back to post it.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23223-05-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say that you will ask what reply method is needed and return to send the postcard if necessary. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23223-05-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23223-05-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: それでは、ご友人へご確認ください。お気をつけて。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23223-05-001-SHARED-11.translation: Please check with your friend, then. Take care.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23223-06-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23223-06-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 旅行中のカード利用についてのお尋ねですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23223-06-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you asking about using your card while traveling?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23223-06-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23223-06-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。来月海外へ行きます。このカードで現地の現金を出せるか、出発する前に確認したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23223-06-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 海外旅行前に手持カードの現地現金引出し可否を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23223-06-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. I am going abroad next month. Before I leave, I would like to check whether I can withdraw local cash with this card.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23223-06-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask before traveling abroad whether your current card can be used to withdraw local cash. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23223-06-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23223-06-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: お持ちのカードの種類を確認します。お買い物で使いたいのではなく、現金の引出しですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23223-06-001-SHARED-03.translation: I will check what type of card you have. You mean withdrawing cash, rather than using it for shopping, correct?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23223-06-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23223-06-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: そうです。店で払う話ではありません。旅行先はベトナムで、一週間滞在する予定です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23223-06-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 買物決済でなくベトナム一週間の現金利用と説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23223-06-001-SHARED-04.translation: That's right. I am not talking about paying in shops. My destination is Vietnam, and I plan to stay for one week.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23223-06-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that you mean obtaining cash for a one-week stay in Vietnam rather than paying for shopping. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23223-06-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23223-06-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 海外での取扱いは、カードや登録の条件によります。担当でご案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23223-06-001-SHARED-05.translation: Overseas availability depends on the card and registration conditions. The staff member in charge will advise you.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23223-06-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23223-06-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: このカードの条件を確かめたいです。出発までに必要な手続きがあれば、教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23223-06-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 手持カードの海外引出し条件と出発前に必要な手続きを尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23223-06-001-SHARED-06.translation: I would like to check the conditions for this card. Please tell me if there are any procedures I need to complete before departure.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23223-06-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ask about the conditions for overseas cash withdrawals with your current card and any procedures needed before departure. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23223-06-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23223-06-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 利用できる場合も、手数料や限度などをご確認ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23223-06-001-SHARED-07.translation: Even if it can be used, please check the fees, limits and other conditions.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23223-06-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23223-06-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 手数料と一回の限度、困った時の連絡先を知りたいです。今のカードで対応できないなら、旅行前に別の準備を考えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23223-06-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 費用限度連絡先を確認し不可時別準備を考えると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23223-06-001-SHARED-08.translation: I would like to know the fee, the limit per withdrawal, and whom to contact if I have trouble. If my current card cannot handle this, I will consider other preparations before my trip.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23223-06-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Check the costs, limits and contact details, and say that you will consider other preparations if the card cannot be used. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23223-06-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23223-06-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 出発の時期も、担当へお伝えください。お手続きが必要かも合わせて確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23223-06-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please also tell the staff member when you are leaving. We will check at the same time whether any procedures are needed.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23223-06-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23223-06-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 来月十日に出発します。現金引出しの希望と国、日程を伝え、使えると確認できてから現地のお金の準備を決めます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23223-06-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 来月十日出発と利用目的国日程を示し確認後準備と話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23223-06-001-SHARED-10.translation: I leave on the tenth of next month. I will explain that I want to withdraw cash, give the country and travel dates, and decide how to prepare local money after confirming that the card can be used.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23223-06-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: State that you leave on the tenth of next month, give the purpose, country and itinerary, and say that you will prepare after confirmation. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23223-06-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23223-06-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: それでは、担当窓口へご案内します。こちらへどうぞ。失礼します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23223-06-001-SHARED-11.translation: I will take you to the appropriate counter, then. This way, please. Excuse me.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23223-07-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23223-07-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 紙パックの回収について、お尋ねですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23223-07-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you asking about carton recycling?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23223-07-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23223-07-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。牛乳のパックを洗って持ってきましたが、まだ内側が少し湿っています。このまま回収箱へ入れてよいでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23223-07-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 洗ったが内側湿る牛乳パックの回収可否を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23223-07-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. I washed these milk cartons and brought them, but they are still a little damp inside. May I put them in the collection box like this?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23223-07-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask whether washed milk cartons that are still damp inside can be collected. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23223-07-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23223-07-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: こちらでは、洗って開き、乾かした物を入れてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23223-07-001-SHARED-03.translation: Here, please put in cartons that have been washed, cut open and dried.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23223-07-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23223-07-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 洗うだけで準備が終わったと思っていました。まだ開いていない物もあるので、今日は箱へ入れず持ち帰ります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23223-07-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 洗浄のみとせず未展開湿潤品を当日持帰ると述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23223-07-001-SHARED-04.translation: I thought washing them was all the preparation needed. Some have not been cut open yet either, so I will take them home today instead of putting them in the box.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23223-07-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say that washing alone is insufficient and that you will take the unopened, damp cartons home today. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23223-07-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23223-07-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 開く時は、けがをしないようご注意ください。対象の種類も掲示でご確認ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23223-07-001-SHARED-05.translation: Please be careful not to injure yourself when cutting them open. Also check the sign for the types accepted.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23223-07-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23223-07-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 今日持っているのは、この牛乳の紙パックです。家で開いて乾かしてから、次の買い物の時に持ってきます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23223-07-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 対象牛乳パックを示し自宅展開乾燥後に再持参と話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23223-07-001-SHARED-06.translation: What I have today are these milk cartons. I will cut them open and dry them at home, then bring them on my next shopping trip.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23223-07-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Show the milk cartons concerned and say that you will bring them back after opening and drying them at home. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23223-07-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23223-07-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 一緒に入れている袋は、回収箱へ入れないでください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23223-07-001-SHARED-07.translation: Please do not put the bag containing them into the collection box.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23223-07-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23223-07-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 袋は私の布袋です。乾いたパックを取り出して入れ、布袋は持って帰るようにします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23223-07-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 布袋は自己持帰りで乾燥パックだけ投入と伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23223-07-001-SHARED-08.translation: The bag is my cloth bag. I will take out the dried cartons and put only those in, and take the cloth bag home.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23223-07-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say that you will put only the dried cartons in and take your cloth bag home yourself. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23223-07-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23223-07-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 回収場所は、こちらの箱です。まだ湿った分は袋へお戻しください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23223-07-001-SHARED-09.translation: This is the collection box. Please put the damp ones back in your bag.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23223-07-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23223-07-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 湿った分を袋に戻しました。今日は持ち帰って、家で開いて乾かします。回収箱の場所も覚えました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23223-07-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 湿った分を回収せず袋へ戻し自宅で開いて乾かすと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23223-07-001-SHARED-10.translation: I have put the damp ones back in the bag. I will take them home today and open and dry them there. I also remember where the collection box is now.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23223-07-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say that you have returned the damp cartons to your bag instead of recycling them and will open and dry them at home. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23223-07-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23223-07-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: それでは、ご準備の後にお持ちください。ご協力ありがとうございました。お気をつけて。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23223-07-001-SHARED-11.translation: Please bring them after preparing them, then. Thank you for your cooperation. Take care.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23223-08-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23223-08-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 芝生の方で、何か見つけられましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23223-08-001-SHARED-01.translation: Did you find something on the lawn?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23223-08-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23223-08-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 芝生に空き缶があります。端が裂けているように見えるので、触らずに知らせに来ました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23223-08-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 裂けて見える芝生の缶を未接触で報告する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23223-08-001-SHARED-02.translation: There is an empty can on the lawn. Its edge looks torn, so I came to report it without touching it.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23223-08-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Report a can on the lawn that looks torn, without having touched it. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23223-08-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23223-08-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: そのままにして、場所を教えてください。こちらで回収します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23223-08-001-SHARED-03.translation: Leave it where it is and tell me the location. We will collect it.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23223-08-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23223-08-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: ベンチから二歩くらい先です。草に半分隠れていて、銀色の裂けた所が見えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23223-08-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: ベンチ近く草隠れ缶の具体位置を示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23223-08-001-SHARED-04.translation: It is about two steps beyond the bench. It is half hidden in the grass, and you can see a silver torn part.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23223-08-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Give the specific location of the can hidden in the grass near the bench. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23223-08-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23223-08-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 子どもさんなどが、近くで遊んでいますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23223-08-001-SHARED-05.translation: Are children or anyone else playing nearby?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23223-08-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23223-08-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 子どもたちがボール遊びをしています。缶には触らず、今はベンチ側で待つよう声をかけました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23223-08-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 遊ぶ子へ触らずベンチ側待機を伝えたと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23223-08-001-SHARED-06.translation: Children are playing ball. I told them not to touch the can and to wait by the bench for now.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23223-08-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Explain that you told the playing children not to touch it and to wait by the bench. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23223-08-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23223-08-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 道具を用意して回収します。それまでは缶から離れてお待ちください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23223-08-001-SHARED-07.translation: We will get tools and collect it. Until then, please wait away from the can.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23223-08-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23223-08-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 分かりました。自分で缶を袋へ入れず、担当の方に見えるよう場所を指します。手を切った人は今のところ見ていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23223-08-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 自己回収せず場所指示し負傷者未目撃と述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23223-08-001-SHARED-08.translation: Understood. I will not put it in a bag myself; I will point out its location so the person in charge can see it. So far, I have not seen anyone cut their hand.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23223-08-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say that you will point out the location instead of collecting it yourself and have not seen anyone injured. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23223-08-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23223-08-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 回収しました。このあたりも確認しておきます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23223-08-001-SHARED-09.translation: We have collected it. We will also check the surrounding area.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23223-08-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23223-08-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: ありがとうございます。缶がなくなったことを子どもへ伝えます。ほかに見つけた時も、触らずに知らせます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23223-08-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 回収後子へ知らせ今後も未接触で報告すると話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23223-08-001-SHARED-10.translation: Thank you. I will tell the children that the can has been removed. If I find anything else, I will report it without touching it too.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23223-08-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say that you will inform the children after collection and continue reporting such items without touching them. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23223-08-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23223-08-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: お知らせくださって助かりました。それでは、公園でよい時間をお過ごしください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23223-08-001-SHARED-11.translation: Thank you for letting us know; that helped. Enjoy your time in the park.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23224-01-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23224-01-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 駅案内です。どちらへ向かう列車をお探しですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23224-01-001-SHARED-01.translation: Station information. Which direction are you looking for a train to?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23224-01-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23224-01-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 花浜方面へ行きます。十時二分の列車を待っていますが、時刻表の上には反対側の駅名が書いてあります。違う方向を見ていたかもしれません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23224-01-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 反対方面の時刻表を見た可能性を目的地とともに電話で伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23224-01-001-SHARED-02.translation: I am going toward Hanahama. I am waiting for the 10:02 train, but the station name at the top of the timetable is in the opposite direction. I may have been looking at the wrong direction.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23224-01-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: On the phone, give your destination and explain that you may have been looking at the timetable for the opposite direction. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23224-01-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23224-01-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 今ご覧の表は、山側方面です。花浜方面は隣の表です。お手元でそちらを見られますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23224-01-001-SHARED-03.translation: The timetable you are looking at is for the mountain direction. The Hanahama timetable is next to it. Can you look at that one where you are?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23224-01-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23224-01-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 隣の表に花浜方面と書いてあります。次は十時八分ですね。さっき見た二分の列車とは別なのですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23224-01-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 隣の花浜方面表の十時八分を見つけ誤認を訂正する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23224-01-001-SHARED-04.translation: The timetable next to it says toward Hanahama. The next one is at 10:08, right? So it is different from the train at two minutes past that I saw earlier.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23224-01-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Find 10:08 on the neighboring Hanahama timetable and correct your misunderstanding. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23224-01-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23224-01-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 今から花浜方面へ向かうなら、十時八分の列車をご確認ください。案内図では二番ホームです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23224-01-001-SHARED-05.translation: If you are heading toward Hanahama now, please check the 10:08 train. The station map shows platform two.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23224-01-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23224-01-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 二番ですね。まだ改札へ入っていません。先に行き先を確認できたので、反対方向の列車には乗らずに済みました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23224-01-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 二番ホームを聞き未入場で反対方向へ乗らないと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23224-01-001-SHARED-06.translation: Platform two, right. I have not gone through the ticket gates yet. Since I could check the destination first, I have avoided boarding a train in the opposite direction.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23224-01-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Acknowledge platform two and say that you have not entered the gates and will not board in the opposite direction. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23224-01-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23224-01-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 改札を通った後も、ホームの行き先表示をご覧ください。電話の案内だけで決めないようお願いします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23224-01-001-SHARED-07.translation: After passing the gates, please also check the destination display on the platform. Please do not decide solely on the telephone guidance.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23224-01-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23224-01-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 二番ホームの表示でも花浜方面か確かめます。似た時間だからと、二分の方へ急ぐことはしません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23224-01-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: ホーム表示も確認し二分列車へ急がないと確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23224-01-001-SHARED-08.translation: I will check that the display on platform two also says toward Hanahama. I will not rush to the train at two minutes past just because the times are similar.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23224-01-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Confirm that you will also check the platform display and will not rush to the train at two minutes past. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23224-01-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23224-01-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: ほかに、乗り継ぎの確認も必要でしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23224-01-001-SHARED-09.translation: Do you also need to check any connections?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23224-01-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23224-01-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 花浜まで直通で行きたいです。方向と八分の時刻をメモできました。ありがとうございました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23224-01-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 直通で行きたいと伝え方向と八分の時刻を記録する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23224-01-001-SHARED-10.translation: I would like to go straight through to Hanahama without changing. I have noted down the direction and the time at eight minutes past. Thank you.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23224-01-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say that you want a direct train and record the direction and the time at eight minutes past. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23224-01-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23224-01-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: どういたしまして。それでは、表示をご確認のうえご乗車ください。お気をつけて。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23224-01-001-SHARED-11.translation: You're welcome. Please check the displays before boarding, then. Have a safe journey.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23224-02-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23224-02-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: ご依頼の証明書です。お名前などをご確認ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23224-02-001-SHARED-01.translation: Here is the certificate you requested. Please check your name and the other details.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23224-02-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23224-02-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: この名前の最後の文字が、私の資料と違います。似ていますが、ここは長い線がありません。受け取る前に確認してもらえますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23224-02-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 発行証明の氏名末尾字が資料と異なると受領前に指摘する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23224-02-001-SHARED-02.translation: The last character of this name differs from the one on my document. They look similar, but this one does not have a long stroke. Could you check before I accept it?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23224-02-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Before accepting the issued certificate, point out that the final character of your name differs from your document. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23224-02-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23224-02-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 比較できる資料を、お持ちでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23224-02-001-SHARED-03.translation: Do you have a document we can compare it with?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23224-02-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23224-02-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: この本人確認の資料です。こちらの名前を指で示します。音は同じなので、読み上げだけでは分からなかったです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23224-02-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 本人資料の該当文字を示し同音でも字が違うと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23224-02-001-SHARED-04.translation: Here is my identification document. I will point to the name here. Since they sound the same, I could not tell just from hearing it read aloud.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23224-02-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Point to the relevant character on your identification and explain that the characters differ even though they sound the same. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23224-02-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23224-02-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 字の違いを確認します。登録された内容と今回の発行内容を、担当に照会します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23224-02-001-SHARED-05.translation: We will check the difference in the characters. We will ask the person in charge to check the registered details against what was issued this time.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23224-02-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23224-02-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: お願いします。紙へ自分で線を足して使うのではなく、どこで違いが生じたかを確認したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23224-02-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 紙を自分で訂正せず登録と発行の相違確認を頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23224-02-001-SHARED-06.translation: Please do. Instead of adding a stroke to the paper myself and using it, I would like to check where the discrepancy arose.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23224-02-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ask for the discrepancy between registration and issuance to be checked rather than correcting the paper yourself. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23224-02-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23224-02-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: この証明書はいったんお預かりします。提出の予定は、いつでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23224-02-001-SHARED-07.translation: We will hold this certificate for now. When do you plan to submit it?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23224-02-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23224-02-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 来週の月曜です。今日はまだ提出していません。確認に時間がかかるなら、その予定を担当へ伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23224-02-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 未提出と月曜の期限を伝えて担当へ共有を頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23224-02-001-SHARED-08.translation: Next Monday. I have not submitted it yet today. If checking will take time, please tell the person in charge about that schedule.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23224-02-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say that you have not submitted it and have a Monday deadline, and ask that the person in charge be informed. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23224-02-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23224-02-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 月曜の提出予定もお伝えします。お客様の資料は照合後にお返しします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23224-02-001-SHARED-09.translation: I will also tell them that you plan to submit it on Monday. We will return your document after comparing it.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23224-02-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23224-02-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 分かりました。違う文字の紙をそのまま持って帰らず、担当の確認と説明を待ちます。資料も返却時に確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23224-02-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 相違のある紙を持ち帰らず確認説明と資料返却を待つ。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23224-02-001-SHARED-10.translation: Understood. I will wait for the person in charge to check and explain, instead of taking home the paper with the wrong character as it is. I will also check my document when it is returned.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23224-02-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say that you will not take home the paper with the discrepancy and will wait for verification, an explanation and the return of your document. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23224-02-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23224-02-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: それでは、照合にお時間をいただきます。こちらでお待ちください。失礼いたします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23224-02-001-SHARED-11.translation: Please allow us some time to compare them, then. Please wait here. Excuse me.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23224-03-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23224-03-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 問診票の記入について、お困りの所はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23224-03-001-SHARED-01.translation: Is there anything you need help with when filling in the medical questionnaire?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23224-03-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23224-03-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 症状を忘れないよう、携帯に声でメモしました。でも、吐いていないと話した所が、吐いたという文になっています。このまま見せると違うことが伝わりそうです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23224-03-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 音声入力が吐いていないを吐いたという文にしたため訂正したいと相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23224-03-001-SHARED-02.translation: I used voice input to make a note on my phone so I would not forget my symptoms. But where I said I had not vomited, it turned into a sentence saying I had. If I show it as it is, I may convey the wrong thing.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23224-03-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that voice input changed 'I have not vomited' into 'I vomited' and ask about correcting it. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23224-03-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23224-03-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 実際の状態と違う文が入っているのですね。ご自身は、どのような様子だったか説明できますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23224-03-001-SHARED-03.translation: So there is a sentence that differs from your actual condition. Can you explain what you actually experienced?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23224-03-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23224-03-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 昨日の夕食の後から、気持ちが悪くなりました。実際に吐いたことはありません。今も少し気持ちが悪いです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23224-03-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 夕食後からの吐き気と実際に吐いていないこと、現在も少し続くことを説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23224-03-001-SHARED-04.translation: I started feeling nauseous after dinner yesterday. I have not actually vomited. I still feel a little nauseous now.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23224-03-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that you have felt nauseous since after dinner, have not actually vomited, and still feel a little nauseous now. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23224-03-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23224-03-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: その経過を、ご自身の言葉で問診票へ書いてください。携帯のメモも、実際の内容に直して診察で見せられます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23224-03-001-SHARED-05.translation: Please write that progression on the questionnaire in your own words. You can also correct the note on your phone to reflect what actually happened and show it during your consultation.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23224-03-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23224-03-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 漢字を選び間違えそうなので、かなで、きもちがわるい、はいていないと書いてもよいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23224-03-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 漢字の選択に不安があるため実際の状態をかなで書けるか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23224-03-001-SHARED-06.translation: I am worried I might choose the wrong kanji, so may I write 'I feel nauseous' and 'I have not vomited' in kana?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23224-03-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ask whether you may write your actual condition in kana because you are unsure about selecting kanji. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23224-03-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23224-03-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: かなでもご記入いただけます。いつからかと、現在の様子も添えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23224-03-001-SHARED-07.translation: You may write in kana too. Please add when it started and how you are now.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23224-03-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23224-03-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: きのうのゆうしょくのあとから、きもちがわるい。はいていない。いまもすこし、と書き直しました。これなら、自分が伝えたい内容です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23224-03-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 発症時点と現在の様子を含む訂正メモを読み返し伝えたい内容と一致すると確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23224-03-001-SHARED-08.translation: I have rewritten it as: 'Since after dinner yesterday, I have felt nauseous. I have not vomited. Still a little now.' This says what I want to convey.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23224-03-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Read back the corrected note, including when symptoms began and your current condition, and confirm that it matches what you want to convey. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23224-03-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23224-03-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: そのメモを診察でもご説明ください。問診票にも、相談したい症状が分かるように記入できましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23224-03-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please also explain that note during your consultation. Have you been able to fill in the questionnaire so that it shows the symptoms you want to discuss?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23224-03-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23224-03-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 問診票には、昨日から気持ちが悪いと書きました。詳しい経過はこの直したメモを見せて、診察で自分から話します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23224-03-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 問診票の短い症状記入と訂正済メモの詳しい経過を診察で合わせて説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23224-03-001-SHARED-10.translation: I wrote on the questionnaire that I have felt nauseous since yesterday. I will show this corrected note for the detailed progression and explain it myself during the consultation.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23224-03-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: During the consultation, explain both the brief symptom entry on the questionnaire and the detailed progression in the corrected note. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23224-03-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23224-03-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: では、問診票をお預かりします。携帯は診察でご用意ください。それでは、ご案内までお待ちください。お大事になさってください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23224-03-001-SHARED-11.translation: I will take the questionnaire, then. Please have your phone ready for your consultation. Please wait until we call you in. Take care, and I hope you feel better.
